name: Mountain Lamp Community
reason: No centre of its own: its practice home, Wild Rose Farm, closed in 2022 and the community now meets in rented halls (monthly Quiet Days in Mount Vernon, Washington) and on Zoom; retreat registration is closed and the 2026 calendar is mostly past. The site has teacher talk pages and a logo but no photo of a place. Contact ml-info@mountainlamp.org is published (contact page). Possible future listing: Jack Duffy Roshi (also teaches at Three Treasures Sangha).
